entries.title: Going Medieval

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Going Medieval left Early Access as a PC release on Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG. No sourced console or mobile release was found in this pass, so the Windows PC build is both the complete route and the highest-fidelity capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC 1.0 release through Steam, GOG, or Epic Games Store. Use the latest patch before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with current 1.0 content, patch support, and storefront choice across Steam, GOG, and Epic.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and best capture/settings route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate platform or edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster, definitive edition, or platform-exclusive content exists.
